headline: Agents are working on Hodge loci of combinations of three cycles. A candidate finding (a conic of special coefficients on one quartic sixfold) is waiting for an independent check.

active.title: Three or more cycles: special coefficients
active.summary: For three 3-planes in one P^4 on a quartic sixfold, the coefficients (a0 : a : b) where the first-order Hodge locus jumps appear to be the six lines predicted by pairs PLUS a conic that moves with the hypersurface. Exact over QQ at one instance (by the team that found it); an independent check with separate code is running. On cubic sixfolds and quartic fourfolds, nothing was found off the pairwise lines.

recent.what: Three-cycle target: candidate conic of special coefficients found (exact at one instance); blind check started.

Survey of related work: one-cycle results of Kloosterman (arXiv:2104.14845) and Dan noted; Movasati's 2019 Fermat-surface tables cross-checked (1758 records agree at first order; 42 records differ at second order outside the range, unresolved).
Software package HodgeLociCI 0.1.0 and this discoveries registry published; one blind install check, all 28 findings fixed.
Discovery round closed: explicit families for coefficient -1 (sums of two determinants) and 1 (Pfaffians) on cubic sixfolds; no unexplained piece found for fake linear cycles on quartic sixfolds.
